stories.title: Week 1: The league board
stories.body: JD Daley 147.36–158.26 Bryan Hunt; Thomas Speer 101.30–115.96 George Travis; Trevor Hash 192.56–90.32 Kyle Fowler; Collin Krum 89.26–104.22 German Haro; Jared Hall 142.00–154.90 Vincent Cannarozzi; Brian Heino 78.62–139.76 James Brochu.

stories.title: Trevor Hash delivers the week's biggest win
stories.body: Trevor Hash turned in the week’s loudest statement, beating Kyle Fowler 192.56–90.32 by a margin of 102.24 points.

stories.title: Bryan Hunt survives the closest finish
stories.body: A nail-biter at the top of the board ended 158.26–147.36, with Bryan Hunt edging JD Daley by 10.90 points.

stories.title: Trevor Hash sets the Week 1 pace
stories.body: Trevor Hash supplied the league-high mark with 192.56. At the other end, Brian Heino finished with the week's low score at 78.62.

stories.title: The Week 1 standings take shape
stories.body: The verified top three after Week 1 are Trevor Hash, Bryan Hunt, Vincent Cannarozzi, giving the early table a clear shape.

stories.title: German Haro applies early pressure to the preseason order
stories.body: German Haro won in Week 1 with 104.22 points, a result that follows an opening position of 31.2 in the post-draft rating.
